en: Black-and-white postcard view of a rural road lined with fences and stone posts, leading toward a tall church with a slender spire on the left (Ringsaker Kirke). On the right are large wooden houses with steep roofs and multiple windows, and several telegraph poles with many wires. Leafless trees and forested hills appear in the background. Printed captions in Norwegian identify the scene and the photographer/publisher, dated 1922.
